request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, gentle strings, hopeful and serene mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, hear my voice as I call to you
Let your ears be attentive to my cry
If you kept a record of my sins
Who could stand before you?

[Chorus]
I wait for the Lord, my soul waits
And in his word I put my hope
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen wait for the morning

[Verse]
But with you there is forgiveness
So that you may be feared
I wait for the Lord, my soul waits
And in his word I put my hope

[Chorus]
I wait for the Lord, my soul waits
And in his word I put my hope
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen wait for the morning

[Bridge]
Israel, hope in the Lord
For with the Lord there is steadfast love
With him is abundant redemption
He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins

[Chorus]
I wait for the Lord, my soul waits
And in his word I put my hope
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen wait for the morning

[Outro]
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen wait for the morning
